amp[0] = FCFAConvert[CreateFeynAmp[diags], IncomingMomenta -> {pH}, OutgoingMomenta -> {k1, k2}, List -> False, ChangeDimension -> 4, DropSumOver -> True, SMP -> True, Contract -> True, UndoChiralSplittings -> True]

ampSquared[0] = 1/2 (amp[0] (ComplexConjugate[amp[0]])) // FeynAmpDenominatorExplicit // DoPolarizationSums[#, k1] & // DoPolarizationSums[#, k2] & // Simplify
